summary.text: John Carmichael is a Democratic state representative from Kansas House District 92 who has served since October 2013 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney from Wichita, he faces Republican Vail Fruechting in the general election.

paragraphs.text: John Carmichael lives in Wichita, Kansas, and earned degrees from Wichita State University and the University of Kansas.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and as an adjunct faculty member at Wichita State University.

He was appointed to the Governor's Committee on Kansas Libraries by Governor Joan Finney and has chaired the Kansas Human Rights Commission and the Kansas Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training.
Carmichael assumed office in the Kansas House on October 16, 2013.
